description: This file defines structures and functions for managing schema version upgrades in JSON data within the PyTorch project. It includes classes for upgrade logic, registration/deregistration functions, and an upgrade utility.

classes.name: Upgrader
classes.description: Represents an upgrade operation for a specific JSON keypath, including the path and upgrade function.

methods.name: Upgrader
methods.description: Constructor for creating an Upgrader with a keypath and upgrade function.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Comparator for ordering Upgrader instances, processing deeper keypaths first.
